name: SemanticKITTI — Point Cloud Segmentation Benchmark
description: Pioneering large-scale LiDAR semantic segmentation and panoptic benchmark developed by the University of Bonn. Based on the 22 sequences of the KITTI Vision Odometry Benchmark, it provides point-wise semantic annotations across 28 distinct classes (including static road structures, vehicles, cyclists, and moving objects) for all 43,552 rotating Velodyne HDL-64E laser scans, totaling more than 4.5 billion individually labeled 3D points.

provenance.collection_method: Pointwise labeling of all 22 Velodyne HDL-64E LiDAR sequences from the KITTI Odometry Benchmark.
provenance.curation_notes: Reuses raw sensor data from the KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite (Geiger et al. 2012). University of Bonn independently created new pointwise semantic, panoptic, and semantic scene completion annotations across 28 classes, establishing an independent benchmark suite with its own evaluation servers and leaderboards.
